outcome: #594 fixed: Experiments whose Metrics read robot state or the field open again
owner_impact: Opening an Experiment runs a check first. That check compiled the Metrics without the robots' memory, traits and the field, so any Experiment whose Metrics use them was refused with 'cannot run in the current simulator version', even though it runs correctly. It blocked the corrected Firat aggregation, Emergent Taxis and Collective Gradient Perception, and two of the audit copies. The check now uses the same information as the run, and all nine audit Experiments open. Test now: yes. Open the collection 'Audit fixes — 26 Sep 2026 (to check)', open the Firat aggregation Experiment and run it; the aggregation plot fills in.

next.text: #594 is closed. The four Showcase Experiments are ready for your check in the audit collection.

technical_evidence: experiment-validation.js compileExperiment passes agentState (Controller state) and runtimeCapabilities (environment_scalar) to compileMetrics, matching metrics-runtime-bridge.js.
New test: every recorded reference Experiment and a minimal state-plus-field Metrics Experiment pass productionExperimentRunnability; both fail on the previous code.
All nine audit Experiments exported from production: 5 blocked before, 9 open after. Web tests 725 pass; tsc, build, verify-dist, mirrored browser smoke and startup-recovery smoke pass.
